row.evidence: Modern Health publishes no pricing (employers are asked to "request a demo") and its own pages never mention SCIM; members are enrolled from the employer's eligibility file, and only Okta's catalogue lists a Modern Health app with SCIM.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans or prices (/pricing returns 404). SCIM evidence comes only from the Okta OIN listing (SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate marked), so per the rules the status is unknown rather than gated. The vendor's help centre describes Okta/SSO sign-in for members and enrolment via employer eligibility files uploaded weekly to quarterly. Admin access to the Modern Health Central portal is managed by hand by Super Admins. No public API.

scim.notes: Only evidence of SCIM is Okta's OIN listing (SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate checked in page markup). Modern Health's own site and help centre never mention SCIM; members are added via the employer's eligibility file.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked (read from page markup); Group Push not marked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Employer eligibility file uploads (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or quarterly) determine who can register.
